displayName: C# WinForms / WebForms → .NET 10 Blazor Web App (SSR + Interactive) + xUnit
description: Reference scaffold for migrating WinForms and WebForms applications to Blazor Web App (.NET 10) in SSR + Interactive Server mode. Applies to InfinityQS ProFicient (#8 — WinForms quality metrics UI) and PQ Systems GAGEpack/SQCpack (#16 — desktop gauge calibration). Form controls become Blazor @page components with cascading scoped state services. DataGridView → <Virtualize> over List<T>. Timer → PeriodicTimer in IHostedService. System.Windows.Forms.* removed entirely. EF Core 10 for DB access (replaces DataTable/DataAdapter). SQL Server connection via IDbContextFactory<T> for thread-safe Singleton-owned access. Serilog for structured logging. xUnit + bUnit for component tests.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the spec's target_archetype_hint is 'BlazorWebApp' and schemaId is 'csharp'. Primary target for former WinForms and WebForms applications.
